source_school: Harvard College Dean of Students Office Staff
bio: I work alongside the Resident Dean in Dunster House to assist students with a wide range of academic and administrative matters, including registration, add/drop/withdrawal, grading basis changes, independent study, and more. I also support students through Ad Board processes such as leaves of absence, extensions, and makeup exams. Additionally, I assist the Pre-Med team with medical and dental school applications, particularly in managing letters of recommendation. I am also here to answer any questions about graduation and the Commencement ceremony. In my free time, I enjoy reading, walking in scenic places, listening to podcasts, and spending time with my family. Please don't hesitate to contact me with any questions or concerns.
